XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Engine fault light comes on following alternator replacement
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | ELECTRONICS | ALTERNATOR | GENERATOR | CODING | PROGRAMMING | DIAGNOSIS | U0413 |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Electronics

  • Device: Alternator

  • Fault: Engine fault warning light comes on after replacing the alternator

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: U0413 (Invalid data received from battery power control unit B)

  • Cause: New alternator coding required

• Intervention: When replacing the alternator, use diagnostic equipment to reset the cumulative counter for overheating on the alternator.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: This procedure is not necessary when replacing the voltage regulator or simply disconnecting/reconnecting the alternator itself.
